title: Initiative Tracker Slow-Round Hotspots
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:initiative encounter_type=* round_duration_sec=*
| stats avg(round_duration_sec) as avg_round_duration_sec, count as events by encounter_type
| sort - avg_round_duration_sec
description: Shows average round duration seconds by encounter type for initiative rounds.
value: Average round duration seconds by encounter type helps compare initiative rounds across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `round_duration_sec` on `rpg:initiative` events and normalize `encounter_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by encounter type.
visualization: Bar chart of average round duration seconds by encounter type.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors the average round duration seconds for each encounter type so you can see what works best for initiative rounds.
